title: Onlook is back: the open-source developer tool for designers
description:
Onlook is the open-source developer tool for designers – a desktop app that opens any repo and puts your real product on a canvas, so you can explore ideas with your agent and refine them in actual code.

In this video I design 5 real projects with it: a calendar app, an editor, a flipdot display, 3D cards, and a synthesizer. Then I show how artifacts work – they're snippets you can remix and reuse.

Free, open source, and every change lands as a normal pull request.

0:00 - Intro
0:33 - Calendar App • Variations
2:30 - Editor • Adding a new panel
3:48 - Flipdot display • Creative visuals
4:30 - 3D Cards • Hero variations
5:15 - Synthesizer • Images as references
6:13 - Artifacts • HTML/CSS Snippets
7:12 - Outro

Visit the GitHub repo and don't forget to star it – https://github.com/onlook-dev/onlook 

Visit our website to learn more about Onlook, and to start designing in real code today – https://onlook.com

Join our Discord to get a sneak-peek of features before they go live - https://discord.gg/ZZzadNQtns
